name: Houndmaster's Whistle refuses a dead Shadowhound, which comes back through Call From The Shadows (#7443)
contract: Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 summons the Shadowhound 50124 and teaches Call From The Shadows 578118, which
resurrects it ('bringing back your Shadow Hound from the dead'). A dead hound was whistled back at once at full
health. Like a stock hunter's Call Pet, the Whistle now refuses while the hound is dead (SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT
27 after the native 'Your pet is dead' message) and summons nothing. Since #1450 the dead hound stays as a corpse
like a hunter pet. Expected: the hound dies and its corpse stays at 0 health; the Whistle then fails with 27 and
the hound stays dead; Call From The Shadows brings the hound back to life.
